description: This Java source file defines the InboundMappingProcessorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for processing inbound ExternalMessage objects, mapping them, and dispatching outcomes within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging framework.

classes.name: ExternalMessageWithSender
classes.description: Inner class representing an ExternalMessage along with its sender ActorRef.

methods.name: determinePoolSize
methods.description: Determines the appropriate thread pool size, capped at maxPoolSize, with logging if configured size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props configuration for the InboundMappingProcessorActor with specified parameters.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns buffer size from mapping configuration.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Sets up message handling for failure status messages, logging warnings.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles DittoRuntimeException by forwarding it to the inboundDispatchingActor.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Wraps ExternalMessage with sender ActorRef into ExternalMessageWithSender.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates an Akka stream Sink that processes ExternalMessageWithSender objects asynchronously, mapping inbound messages and dispatching outcomes.

methods.name: mapInboundMessage
methods.description: Maps ExternalMessageWithSender to InboundMappingOutcomes, handling exceptions and dispatching errors.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToSignal
methods.description: Converts ExternalMessage to InboundMappingOutcomes using inboundMappingProcessor.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgementOrResponse
methods.description: Appends ConnectionId to CommandResponse or Acknowledgement headers.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgements
methods.description: Applies appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgementOrResponse to a list of acknowledgements.
